Line.DefaultText: I wove it into the hem of the shawl I wear every winter, this one, here. You'd never pick it out from the rest, and that's the point. She's a single thread running through the whole of it, holding, not breaking. So when I tell you a good thread is worth waiting a year for, you understand I mean it more than one way.

Answer.DefaultText: That's the finest thing I've heard in a long while.
